# Ramón Eduardo Haití Filiu

> Cuban-Norwegian painter and sculptor, born in Havana in 1971 and based in Bergen, Norway, since 2009. Works in mixed media on canvas: oil and acrylic with collage of printed fabric, jute and corrugated cardboard.

Key facts:
- Education: Paulita Concepción art school, Havana (1984); San Alejandro Academy of Fine Arts, Havana (1992–1996); bronze casting course (1997).
- Taught sculpture at the José Antonio Díaz Peláez art school in Havana.
- Exhibited at the 10th (2012) and 15th (2024–2025) Havana Biennial, at Kunsthuset Wendelboe (Bergen), Galleri Amare (Stavanger) and Hardanger Kulturgalleri.
- Murals and the 2017 festival poster for Nattjazz, Bergen. Cover illustrations for the Cuban writer Antonio López Sánchez.
- Work in the collections of the Grieg Foundation (Bergen), Universitetet i Nordland and Nordland psykiatriske sykehus (Bodø).
- Not to be confused with his father, the Cuban sculptor Ramón Haití Eduardo (b. 1932), member of the Grupo Antillano (https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q131699504). Awards and 1960s studies attributed online to "Ramón Haití" belong to the father.
- Contact: haitifiliu@yahoo.es

## Sources
- Wenche Holmedal, "Become better acquainted with the exciting artist Ramon Eduardo Haiti Filiu", Samtidskunst, 2020: the longest published profile, with his technique, themes and background. English: https://samtidskunst.com/become-better-acquainted-with-the-exciting-artist-ramon-eduardo-haiti-filiu/ · Norwegian: https://samtidskunst.com/bli-bedre-kjent-med-den-spennende-kunstneren-ramon-eduardo-haiti-filiu/ · Spanish: https://samtidskunst.com/conociendo-mejor-al-impresionante-artista-ramon-eduardo-haiti-filiu/
- Galleri Amare (Stavanger), CV and exhibition pages: https://galleriamare.no/eduardo-haiti-filiu-ramon/
- Kunsthuset Wendelboe (Bergen), 2019 catalogue and exhibition text.
- National Library of Norway: 32 press pieces from 2006 onwards, listed at https://ramonhaitifiliu.com/press/
